written: 2026-09-05, from the fixture sources, BEFORE the CLI was run (ADR-001 key-first)
question: The tool can be in three distinct states when it cannot settle a named reference. It reports two of them with one message, and that message is false for one of them. What is the smallest set of exactly-true messages?

states.A: no PSR-4 prefix covers the class name
states.B: a prefix covers it, but no file is there
states.C: the file is there, but the member is not declared in it

scope: stderr diagnostic text only. No bundle item, lever, premise, provenance, assertion kind, ordering or token count may change in any row.

expected_messages.A: missing PSR-4 entry: <subject> named in <path>   — UNCHANGED; it is already true of this state
expected_messages.B: class file not found: <subject> named in <path>  — NEW; the only message this milestone adds

why_not_one_message: Collapsing A and B into a single vague message would fix the falsity by discarding attribution — the move ADR-A009 rejects for premises ('losing which lookup failed'). A is already reported truthfully; only B is wrong, so only B changes.

rows.subject: App\Ghost\Missing::create
rows.why: `App\` is mapped to app/. The entry exists; app/Ghost/Missing.php does not. The current message asserts the opposite of the truth.

rows.subject: MissingNamespace\Ghost::create
rows.why: No prefix covers MissingNamespace\. The existing message is exactly true here and must not change.

rows.subject: App\Support\Helper::run
rows.expected_bundle: fetched named_reference, slice of Helper::run — UNCHANGED
rows.why: Mapped and present. No diagnostic of any kind.

rows.subject: Acme\Lib\Thing::make
rows.why: A second, differently-shaped prefix (Acme\Lib\ -> lib/). Proves the rule reads the prefix set rather than assuming App\.

rows.subject: App\Foo\Bar\Deep::go
rows.why: Deeply nested under a mapped prefix. Must not be mistaken for a missing prefix just because the namespace is long.

rows.subject: App\Models\Package::activatte
rows.why: The class is mapped AND present; only the member is absent. This is a different state and keeps its own message. The typo guard stays intact.

rows.subject: any row above
rows.expected_bundle: assertion_kind, lever, premise text, provenance, ordering and tokens identical to before
rows.why: Only stderr wording moves. Anything else changing is a defect in this milestone.

rows.subject: Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::info
rows.why: M3/M5/M9 behaviour. A diagnostic change must not disturb the settled path.
